lens: P9 no-sprawl + DOC-CATALOG + doc-class shape + thin-gateway

findings.title: Triplicate deep-dive-oyatie-sst-consolidation.md violates P9 no-sprawl
findings.evidence: File exists at 3 locations: docs/decisions/specs/deep-dive-oyatie-sst-consolidation.md (21.2K), docs/specs/deep-dive-oyatie-sst-consolidation.md (21.0K), .omc/scratch/deep-dive-oyatie-sst-consolidation.md (20.9K). Diff between decisions/specs and specs copies shows divergent frontmatter (~51 lines modified, +122/-127). Same pattern for deep-dive-trace-oyatie-sst-consolidation.md (19.3/19.5/19.4K).
findings.why: Three near-identical copies with divergent frontmatter guarantee drift. No DOC-CATALOG entry sanctions tri-location; thin-gateway rule (one canonical home per doc) violated.
findings.fix: Designate docs/specs/ as canonical; delete decisions/specs/ + .omc/scratch/ copies; if scratch needed, add a pointer-only stub. Add gateway entry to DOC-CATALOG.md.

findings.title: Five ADR amendments (0003/0007/0019/0050/0052) lack 'Amended on YYYY-MM-DD' marker
findings.evidence: grep over docs/decisions/ADR-000{3,7,19,50,52}*.md returns zero 'Amended on' lines. ADRs 0003/0007/0019/0050 still bear `Status: Proposed`; ADR-0052 bears `Status: Accepted`. No amendment provenance recorded.
findings.why: ADR convention (ADR-0019 doc-catalog-and-update-protocol) requires amendment markers; silent ADR edits break audit chain and violate documentation-adherence lens.
findings.fix: Add `> **Amended on:** 2026-05-1X — <rationale>` block to each ADR; bump status if substantive.

findings.title: autonomy-ceiling.md mirror-duplicated under .omc/standards/ and docs/standards/
findings.evidence: .omc/standards/autonomy-ceiling.md (8.5K) vs docs/standards/autonomy-ceiling.md (9.0K); diff shows divergent frontmatter (`doc_status: published` vs `status: pending approval`, distinct `canonical_authority`, `enforced_by`, lift_target removed). No DOC-CATALOG dual-tracking sanction located.
findings.why: Mirror dual-tracking with divergent metadata produces ambiguity over which is authoritative; lift_target field in .omc copy implies it should have been lifted then deleted, not retained.
findings.fix: Delete .omc/standards/autonomy-ceiling.md after confirming docs/standards/ supersedes; or add explicit ADR sanctioning shadow-copy with sync gate.

findings.title: docs/CHANGELOG.md not updated for this consolidation PR
findings.evidence: docs/CHANGELOG.md head shows entries dated 2026-05-15 covering fitness-lane scaffolds; no entry for PR #15 SST consolidation / 5-ADR amendments / autonomy-ceiling promotion. ADR-0019 update protocol requires CHANGELOG touch.
findings.why: Consolidation that amends 5 ADRs + promotes a standard without CHANGELOG entry breaks the doc-update protocol the same PR is amending (ADR-0019).
findings.fix: Add 2026-05-1X CHANGELOG entry summarizing ADR amendments, autonomy-ceiling promotion, SST consolidation scope.

findings.title: DOC-CATALOG.md missing entries for deep-dive specs and autonomy-ceiling standard
findings.evidence: grep 'deep-dive|autonomy-ceiling|consolidation' on DOC-CATALOG.md yields only 3 incidental hits: line 88 (adr_consolidation_plan), 142 (foundry capability list mentions autonomy-ceiling), 289 (adr-citation lane). No template/gateway entry registering deep-dive-oyatie-sst-consolidation.md or autonomy-ceiling.md as cataloged docs.
findings.why: Thin-gateway rule requires every published doc to have a DOC-CATALOG entry naming canonical path + doc_class + shape. Missing entries enable the triplication observed in C1.
findings.fix: Add catalog rows: doc.deep_dive_sst_consolidation → docs/specs/...; doc.standard_autonomy_ceiling → docs/standards/autonomy-ceiling.md with shape + length_cap.

findings.title: Frontmatter shape inconsistency post-promotion (autonomy-ceiling)
findings.evidence: Promoted copy adds `date: 2026-05-12`, `status: Accepted`; older copy retained `status: pending approval`. doc_class/shape/length_cap retained — but `lift_target` field stripped without an ADR note.
findings.why: Doc-class shape drift across promotions undermines lane fitness checks.
findings.fix: Document the lift_target retirement in CHANGELOG or ADR-0019 follow-up.

open_questions: Is .omc/scratch/ deliberately excluded from P9 no-sprawl by an ADR I did not locate? If yes, that ADR should be cited in DOC-CATALOG.
Was ADR-0019 itself updated to RELAX the 'Amended on' requirement? If yes, C2 severity drops.
